title: Cross-cloud infrastructure for the agentic enterprise
description: Explores the infrastructure transformation required for enterprise AI agents operating across multi-cloud and sovereign environments. Details four core architectural pillars: Fluid Compute (TPU v8, Axion ARM CPUs, GKE Agent Sandbox with gVisor isolation), Secure Cross-Cloud Connectivity, Unified Data Layer (combating data gravity), and Digital Sovereignty. Features case studies from Lovable, Walmart, and CSSF.

segments.heading: The infrastructure renaissance: inference dominance and agent demand
segments.text: AI inference has grown to represent nearly half of all cloud AI workloads, eclipsing model training. Autonomous agents execute multi-step tool calls at machine speed, stressing legacy networks and compute clusters. Over 350 enterprise customers processed more than 100 billion tokens monthly, requiring infrastructure that dynamically adapts to high-throughput, low-latency agentic spikes.

segments.heading: Fluid compute: TPU v8, Google Axion ARM CPUs, and GKE Agent Sandbox
segments.text: Fluid compute pairs specialized AI accelerators with flexible CPUs: 8th-generation TPUs handle high-volume inference while Google Axion ARM CPUs provide 2x better price-performance for orchestration and data preparation. GKE Agent Sandbox uses open-source gVisor kernel isolation to spin up secure, sandboxed code execution environments in under one second, scaling up to 300 sandboxes per second per cluster with instant suspend/resume snapshots.

segments.heading: Network performance and storage throughput for enterprise workloads
segments.text: Google Cloud introduces network-optimized C4 VM instances delivering 95 million packets per second and 400 Gbps VM-to-VM bandwidth. In-memory database workloads (SAP HANA, Oracle on M4) combine with Hyperdisk Extreme to achieve 1 million IOPS and 25 GB/s throughput, lowering total cost of ownership by 20% compared to other hyperscalers.

segments.heading: Unified data layer and digital sovereignty in multi-cloud operations
segments.text: Case studies demonstrate cross-cloud architecture in action: Lovable executes over 200,000 daily AI-generated apps inside GKE Agent Sandboxes; Walmart overcomes global data gravity to synchronize supply chain telemetry; Luxembourg's financial regulator (CSSF) deploys AI risk-monitoring agents within sovereign cloud boundaries without compromising innovation pace.
